cards.card_text: The LORD says the people of the hill country, all the Sidonians, will be driven out before the Israelites.
cards.verse_text: All the inhabitants of the hill country from Lebanon to Misrephoth-maim—all the Sidonians—I Myself will drive out before the Israelites.
cards.snippet: All the inhabitants of the hill country from Lebanon to Misrephoth-maim—all the Sidonians—I Myself will drive out before the Israelites.

cards.card_text: Here's the lineup: the five rulers of the Philistines, all the Canaanites, the Sidonians, and the Hivites up in the mountains of Lebanon.
cards.verse_text: the five rulers of the Philistines, all the Canaanites, the Sidonians, and the Hivites who lived in the mountains of Lebanon from Mount Baal-hermon to Lebo-hamath.

cards.card_text: He names the nations that oppressed them before: the Egyptians, Amorites, Ammonites, Philistines, Sidonians, Amalekites and Maonites.
cards.verse_text: The LORD replied, “When the Egyptians, Amorites, Ammonites, Philistines, Sidonians, Amalekites, and Maonites oppressed you and you cried out to Me, did I not save you from their hands?

cards.card_text: The people of Laish have an alliance with the Sidonians, the people of the city of Sidon.
cards.verse_text: So the five men departed and came to Laish, where they saw that the people were living securely, like the Sidonians, quiet and unsuspecting.
cards.snippet: …Laish, where they saw that the people were living securely, like the Sidonians, quiet and unsuspecting.

cards.card_text: Nobody in Israel logs like the Sidonians Hiram owes David a very big favor Hiram's workers ask for the lowest wages
cards.verse_text: My servants will be with your servants, and I will pay your servants whatever wages you set, for you know that there are none among us as skilled in logging as the Sidonians.”
cards.snippet: …that there are none among us as skilled in logging as the Sidonians.”

cards.card_text: Solomon follows Ashtoreth, the goddess of the Sidonians, and Milcom, the abomination of the Ammonites.
cards.verse_text: Solomon followed Ashtoreth the goddess of the Sidonians and Milcom the abomination of the Ammonites.

cards.card_text: The LORD names the gods: Ashtoreth the goddess of the Sidonians, Chemosh the god of the Moabites and Milcom the god of the Ammonites.
cards.verse_text: For they have forsaken Me to worship Ashtoreth the goddess of the Sidonians, Chemosh the god of the Moabites, and Milcom the god of the Ammonites.

cards.card_text: And as if it were not enough for him to walk in the sins of Jeroboam, Ahab marries Jezebel, the daughter of Ethbaal king of the Sidonians.
cards.verse_text: And as if it were not enough for him to walk in the sins of Jeroboam son of Nebat, he even married Jezebel the daughter of Ethbaal king of the Sidonians, and he then proceeded to serve and worship Baal.
cards.snippet: …Nebat, he even married Jezebel the daughter of Ethbaal king of the Sidonians, and he then proceeded to serve and worship Baal.

cards.card_text: They were built for Ashtoreth, Chemosh and Milcom, the abominations of the Sidonians, the Moabites and the Ammonites.
cards.verse_text: The king also desecrated the high places east of Jerusalem, to the south of the Mount of Corruption, which King Solomon of Israel had built for Ashtoreth the abomination of the Sidonians, for Chemosh the abomination of the Moabites, and for Milcom the abomination of the Ammonites.

cards.card_text: Then come the cedar logs, brought to David by the Sidonians and Tyrians, people from Sidon and Tyre.
cards.verse_text: and more cedar logs than could be counted; for the Sidonians and Tyrians had brought a large quantity of cedar logs to David.

cards.card_text: All the leaders of the north and all the Sidonians, the people of the coastal city of Sidon, are there too, gone down in disgrace with the slain.
cards.verse_text: All the leaders of the north and all the Sidonians are there; they went down in disgrace with the slain, despite the terror of their might.
